_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Reynold A. Nicholson (1868-1945). Selected Poems from the Divani Shamsi Tabriz (Rumi, 1898) and Hujwiri's Kashf al-Mahjub (1911). US PD (published before 1931); UK PD since 2016. His Mathnawi (1925-40) is mostly after 1930 and is left out. Added 2026-10-03 by lane C (round 6) under the coordinator's standing instruction to choose further translator shelves; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.

_pending.nicholson-mathnawi: The rest of the Mathnawi (Gibb series, 1925-40): the translation of Books I-II (vol. II, 1926) is now held. Vol. IV (1930) waits on the 1930 ruling; the volumes after 1930 are out. Vols I (1925) and III (1929) were not taken because the series puts the Persian text in the odd volumes; check that before adding either.

_excluded.nicholson-mathnawi-2-reprint: mathnawiofjalalu0006unse is a 1990 reprint of vol. II (reprint list on its verso); the 1926 DLI scan was used.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.

_identity_checked.nicholson-divani-1898: Title page reads 'edited and translated ... by Reynold A. Nicholson ... Cambridge at the University Press 1898'; the OCR spells the name 'NICHQLSON'. Checked by eye 2026-10-03.

nicholson-divani-1898.post_1930_examined: Examined: 'Digitized with financial assistance ... on 06 November, 2019', a scanning credit on the same OCR line as the library stamp, not an imprint. Imprint: Cambridge 1898.

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
_surname_note: 2026-10-03: full printed names only, after Lane D's name audit (a bare one-word form would pass other authors of the same surname, e.g. Maude Ashurst Biggs). Tested against every source on the shelf; the only misses already carry _identity_checked overrides.
